name: @projexlight/hdk-measure
summary: Device-side measurement primitive: tech mobile app uses phone camera + AR depth sensing to measure spaces (room dimensions, panel sizes, ceiling heights) and persist the measurement as a typed evidence-eligible record. The 'tape measure replacement' for field-service blueprints.

endpoints.description: Submit a measurement payload from the mobile app.
Fetch a measurement + its variants (raw, normalized, evidence-bound).
List measurements for a tenant + filters (encounter, persona, date).

events.name: hdk-measure.captured.v1
events.description: Measurement submitted from a device; carries dimensions + units + sensor metadata.

events.name: hdk-measure.normalized.v1
events.description: Measurement normalized to canonical units + bound to encounter / work order.

events.name: hdk-measure.disputed.v1
events.description: Reviewer flagged the measurement as inconsistent with photos / context.

models.description: Per-measurement row: kind (length / area / volume), value, units, sensor_metadata, device_uuid.

hooks.name: submitMeasurement
hooks.description: Service entry — accept a measurement payload + validate against device attestation.

hooks.name: normalizeUnits
hooks.description: Convert to canonical units (meters / m² / m³); idempotent.

hooks.name: bindToEncounter
hooks.description: Attach the measurement to a sdk-engagement encounter as evidence.

hooks.name: disputeMeasurement
hooks.description: Reviewer marks a measurement disputed with reason.

scenarios.title: Tech measures a room with the phone camera
scenarios.when_to_use: Field-service tech needs to estimate paint / flooring; phone AR measures + submits.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Row written; emits .captured.v1. Linked to evidence + later disputable if recheck disagrees.

scenarios.title: Old app submits cm; normalize to canonical m
scenarios.when_to_use: Older client sends cm; normalize hook converts + persists alongside raw.
scenarios.example_code:
import { normalizeUnits } from '@projexlight/hdk-measure';
await normalizeUnits({ measurement_id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Canonical-units row written. .normalized.v1 emitted. Caller decides whether to display raw or normalized.

scenarios.title: Bind measurements to a work-order encounter for proof
scenarios.when_to_use: All measurements for a job link to the encounter so the customer can replay later ("yes, my room really is 18.4 m²").
scenarios.example_code:
import { bindToEncounter } from '@projexlight/hdk-measure';
await bindToEncounter({ measurement_id, encounter_id });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Measurement bound; sdk-evidence registers it as proof. Future disputes resolve against this bind.

scenarios.title: Reviewer disputes a suspiciously small measurement
scenarios.when_to_use: QA reviewer spots a 0.2 m² room — clearly wrong; dispute flags it for retake.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Disputed row; .disputed.v1 emitted. Tech re-measures; both rows retained for the audit trail.

scenarios.title: Submission from unattested device rejected
scenarios.when_to_use: Device attestation must pass before any measurement is accepted — defeats spoofing.
scenarios.example_code:
// Inside submitMeasurement, device attestation status is checked;
// if revoked / failed, the submission errors out before write.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Submission refused with structured error. Mobile app prompts the tech to re-attest. No silent acceptance of unverified data.

compliance_posture.notes: Measurements admissible because they're bound to attested devices (FRE-901 + ISO-9001 traceability). Sensor metadata + dispute trail let an auditor replay the chain of custody.
